Classified structurally as a leaf section of the work, it articulates conditional relations by cross-tabulating the *Ajjhattattika* (triad of internal states) with the *Kusalattika* (triad of wholesome states) according to the standard combinatorial methodology of the *Paṭṭhāna* [SuttaCentral].
